baseline: Each native print piece is a locked stdio write
candidate: Native standard output is gathered in the engine's console and handed to stdio once per run, before stderr, host capabilities and reports
methodology: Physical Alpha. The site in-process ZX runner (-DMATRIX_ZX_UNBOUNDED) built from each revision on the same example bundles, 7 alternating rounds, results checked; native and engine printed identical bytes. Standard: standard-ab, CPU 3, 5 rounds, C digest checked.

examples.unit: µs per call, median of each run's 11 batch medians
